sector_notes: On November 10, SPY fell 0.37%, QQQ 0.68% and IWM 0.68%, while only 35.4% of 3,105 liquid names advanced after hotter October CPI; the 10-year Treasury yield approached 5% and the U.S. bond market was closed for Veterans Day. Across November 6–10, momentum and cyclical leadership remained strongest in MTUM (+4.7%), semiconductors (SMH +4.2%) and industrials (XLI +3.7%), while energy lagged and gold, silver, miners and long-duration Treasuries weakened. The November 11 premarket rebound in AI and semiconductors is event-led by CoreWeave's results and is not yet a confirmed breadth reversal; keep exposure selective and avoid chasing large earnings gaps. Near-term event risk is concentrated in Applied Materials and Cisco after the close on November 12, October PPI on November 13 and NVIDIA results on November 17, with continued AI-infrastructure concentration the main sector-level risk.
